cases.case_label: Japanese founder 3-kb retrotransposal insertion in FKTN in a Chinese patient
cases.mechanism_detail: Chinese FCMD patient compound heterozygous for the Japanese founder 3-kb retrotransposal insertion in the FKTN 3' non-coding region and c.139C>T; mechanism not studied.
cases.quote: Genetic analysis of the fukutin gene showed one copy with a Japanese founder 3-kilobase (kb) retrotransposal insertion in the 3'-non-coding region and the other copy with a known c.139C>T mutation.
